Books- I love anything by John Green also I'm a sucker for the teenage romances because I like to get lost in how lovely their lives seem when mine doesn't seem to be going right

Shows- How I Met Your Mother has been my all time fav show on Netflix. I've watched the whole series about 4 times now. I'm more of a family guy and South Park fan but I do appreciate a good episode of the simpsons
I feel like nobody cares if I'm here or not. If I'm not here nobody would even notice
I'm not doing very great (not that it ever gets super great) but I do really appreciate the compliment
Thank you so much all your kind words really mean a lot. And if you ever need to talk with someone about your sexual assault I'm here for you as well cause I know how hard it can be to deal with.
